_about: Underground lighting in the Godot viewer (T-180, #305): ceiling lights in rooms and corridors, placed by the bridge (src/bridge/scene.ts), and the day and night modes Godot eases between by the hour (godot/src/Lighting.cs). Energies are Godot light energies; reaches in metres.

overhead._about: One ceiling light per room cell (10 m square) and one per corridorSpacingM of corridor, dropM under the ceiling.

day._about: By day, underground: every ceiling light on, lamps lampBoost brighter (0.5 is half again), and colour of the daylight's colour boost (0..1).

night._about: By night: this share of ceiling lights stays on, dimmed to overheadDim; this share of lamps dims to lampDim. Which ones goes by a stable hash of where they are, so the same ones every night.
